_comment: Flavor text bank. Leaf = array of lines. Placeholders: {who} {victim} {enemy} {n} {cause}. Max 70 chars resolved.

generic: Something died. The paperwork is already late.
Casualty logged. Nobody asked who.
One more entry for the Warden's ledger.
A body was involved. Details to follow.
The count changed. Please do not cheer.
Loss recorded under 'expected'.
Another line crossed off the roster.
An incident occurred. It was brief.
The planet took its cut.
Form 12-B filed: 'Well, that happened.'
Statistics have been updated, quietly.
Someone is no longer a problem. Or a person.
Event closed. Reason: finality.
The ledger balances. Barely.
Please file your grief in triplicate.

downed: {who} is down. Please step around the paperwork.
{who} sat down on the job. Involuntarily.
{who} has gone horizontal. Medics, if any.
{who} went down. Productivity down with them.
generic: {who} has left the workforce. Permanently.
{who} filed for retirement. Denied, then granted.
{who} is no longer on payroll. There was no payroll.
{who}: sentence concluded early.
{who} has been reassigned to 'memory'.
{who} will be missed by the schedule.
bleed_out: {who} ran out of blood. Nobody budgeted more.
{who} bled out. The bed was on its way.
{who}: terminal case of too little blood.
{who} lost the argument with gravity and blood.
starvation: {who} starved. The ration was a rumour.
{who} missed the last meal. And every one before.
{who} was owed three days of food. Forgiven.
burn: {who} caught fire. Not an approved perk.
{who} became very warm, then very late.
{who} found the fire. The fire found {who}.
acid: {who} was etched out of the roster.
{who} lost a debate with a spitter.
collapse: {who} was under a rock. Briefly alive.
{who} found out why we have supports.
melee: {who} was bitten by management's problem.
{who} lost a close one with {enemy}.
{enemy} filed a complaint against {who}. In person.
{who} took a {enemy} to the face. Fatal.

destroyed: A building is now a rumour.
The wall gave notice. Effective immediately.
Construction was temporary. Now so is the site.
A building has been redistributed as gravel.

generic: Crawler #{n} filed for retirement. Turret approved it.
Crawler returned to sender. Postage paid in lead.
A crawler was shot. It was a clerical error.
Crawler dismissed without severance.
Crawler removed from the wave. Brief ovation.
Crawler down. Its replacement is on the way.
turret: Crawler took the long way into a turret.
Crawler dealt with. Floor needs a mop.
Crawler tested the turret. Passed, sadly.
melee: Crawler bit {who}. Crawler is not sorry.
Crawler lost the staring contest, then the head.
Crawler stopped by hand. Surprisingly personal.
Crawler cleared with a shovel. Respect.

generic: Brute removed from the wave. Paperwork pending.
Brute stopped. The turret asked for a raise.
Brute refused to stop; it was persuaded.
Brute down. The floor filed a complaint.
Brute retired. Ammo budget did not.
Brute left the premises, horizontally.
turret: Brute reviewed the turret. The turret won.
Brute down at last. Please lower voices.
Brute stopped. Take a long breath.
melee: Brute met an inmate with a grudge. Lost.
Brute stopped at close range. Too close.
Brute was talked down. With a pickaxe.
Brute taken out by hand. Please sit down.

generic: Spitter dissolved in its own opinion.
Spitter's acid ran out, and so did the spitter.
Spitter silenced. The air improved slightly.
Spitter down. Nobody mourns the puddle.
Spitter retired from active spitting.
Spitter returned to goo.
turret: Spitter spat, missed, and was corrected.
Spitter sent off with a bang.
melee: Spitter silenced at arm's length.
Spitter got a close look at a shovel.
Spitter dispatched. Gloves recommended.
Spitter finished off. Messily.

generic: Burrower went down. So did the property value.
Burrower returned to the ground. Permanently.
Burrower surfaced briefly. Got an audit.
Burrower buried by its own hole.
Burrower dispatched. The tunnel remains.
Burrower down; the floor demands a refund.
turret: Burrower dug its last. Floor is uneven.
Burrower removed. Hole stays, as usual.
Burrower's hole now has an owner: gravity.
melee: Burrower met a shovel on the way up.
Burrower popped out and was popped.
Burrower stopped by hand, mid-dig.
Burrower dealt with. Floor needs patching.

wave_incoming: The Warden advises calm. The Warden is not calm.
Inbound guests. Hospitality is not provided.
Heads up: the neighbours are coming over.
A scheduled surprise is en route.
Please locate your nearest turret. Hug it.
Notice: Q3 Teeth Review begins shortly.
Prepare your excuses. Teeth are coming.
Alert: incoming. Smile if you can.
Evacuation is not an option. Neither is optimism.
Please stay at your assigned post. Or behind one.
wave_started: The audit has begun. Please be unremarkable.
Contact. The Warden is taking notes.
They are here. Please look busy.
Wave in progress. Work harder, but behind cover.
Inmates are reminded the pod is not a toy.
All hands to defend the paperwork.
Teeth on the premises. Act accordingly.
Hostile guests inside the fence. Lovely.
The Warden is watching. From a safe place.
Please do not feed the creatures. Or yourselves.
Combat is a form of overtime.
wave_repelled: Visitors dismissed. Thank you for not dying.
Wave repelled. Please return to your quotas.
Audit passed. The creatures were not impressed.
Calm restored. Calm was never ours.
Well done. Credit goes to the turrets.
Damage report to follow. Do not read it.
The visitors have left. They may return.
Cleanup crew is you. Please grab a broom.
Inmates may stand down. Stay near the guns.
Attack ended. Morale unchanged: still low.
That's one fewer problem. For now.
crisis_started: Taint exceeds comfort. Comfort has been revised.
Crisis declared. Please be less in it.
The planet is displeased. Details unavailable.
Warning: air quality now described as 'character'.
An emergency has been scheduled for you.
The Warden regrets nothing. The Warden is alarmed.
Crisis. Please do not use that word loudly.
Conditions are deteriorating. Efficiency is up.
The soil has opinions about your refining.
Something has gone wrong. Specifically yours.
Alarm: the problem is the thing you did.
research_completed: Innovation granted. Your gratitude is mandatory.
Research complete. Do not touch it.
New technology approved by a committee of one.
Progress achieved. The Warden took credit.
Science has occurred. Please file it.
Thank you, researchers. Please do it again.
Good news: a new thing to maintain.
The lab reports a result. It is a result.
Research finished. The budget did not.
colonist_downed: Inmate down. Please do not step on the paperwork.
An inmate is horizontal. Medics, if any.
Attention: someone is lying down on duty.
Inmate in need of bed. Beds in need of inmate.
Medical request noted. Reply in 3-5 weeks.
Inmate down. The queue for care is short: zero.
One inmate has fallen. Gravity commends them.
Stabilise the inmate. Politely, if possible.
Staff shortage detected. It is you.
The infirmary is open. In theory.
Someone is bleeding. Please be efficient.
First aid is available as a concept.
colonist_died: An inmate has been discharged. Permanently.
Staffing level reduced by one. Sentence served.
The Warden sends thoughts. Not funds.
Inmate lost. Please do not ask for a refund.
Moment of silence: one second. Time's up.
Labour pool decreased. Grief is unbudgeted.
Departed inmate's tasks reassigned to you.
Death noted. No bonus was available.
We regret to inform you. We do not regret much.
One fewer mouth. The ration is slightly less sad.
A cot is now free. Silver lining.
Inmate expired before the contract did.
outpost_lost: Outpost lost. Please update the map.
Remote site gone. The map is smaller now.
We have lost contact with a site. Permanently.
An outpost has been repossessed by the planet.
Crew and outpost unreachable. Thoughts and prayers.
Outpost closed due to extreme consequences.
Another asset transferred to the dust.
quiet_day: Nothing happened. The Warden is uneasy.
A calm day. Treat it with suspicion.
No incidents today. The quota is unimpressed.
All is well. This is a mistake.
Nothing to report. The paperwork is lonely.
An uneventful day. Enjoy it. Do not trust it.
The planet is holding its breath.
Peace detected. File a complaint if needed.
Rest day for the walls, at least.
The Warden notes a lack of drama.
informant_report: A report on you was filed. It was flattering to him.
The Informant is thorough. Fees reflect his diligence.
Someone is keeping notes. The Warden thanks him.
Tip received: 'They are counting plates.' Thank you.
Your petition is progressing. Someone has been very helpful.
The review date has been adjusted. For your convenience. Not yours.

working: I was told the pick was ergonomic.
At least the ore doesn't talk back.
Work is the sentence. Also the reward.
I have a system. It's mostly sighing.
fleeing: I have a pod to hide in, and a will to use it.
idle: I'm resting my eyes. And my back.
This is the good part of the sentence.
I'd file a complaint, but I'm resting.
Is it lunch? It feels like lunch.
hungry: Hunger is a form of motivation. I'm told.
The soup would be a luxury.
low_mood: Is it supposed to be this grey?
The Warden's smile is getting to me.
Morale is a state of mind. Mine is elsewhere.
I miss having a ceiling that stays up.
Can I resign? I mean again.
refining: It glows. Is it supposed to glow?
The gauge is in the red. It's fine, probably.
Do not breathe this. I'm breathing this.
wave_won: Put that on my record. Slowly.
We won! Does that mean a raise?
Another day on the wrong side of dead.
Are they all gone? I'm checking nothing.
I think I earned a ribbon.
Tell the Warden I was brave. Just once.

sentence: Life, with time off for complaints
complaint: The ore. It looks at me

generic: {who}. Dug well. Died poorly.
{who}: worked hard. Mostly.
{who}. Left on time, for once.
{who}. Owed 3 days. Forgiven.
{who}: sentence complete. Paperwork not.
{who}. Gone, but still on the rota.
bleed_out: {who}. Ran short of blood. And time.
{who}. A red mark on the ledger.
starvation: {who}. Out of food. Out of patience.

tips: Mining is safe. Refining is a lifestyle choice.
Creatures follow noise. Build a cheaper noise.
A turret is a friend that doesn't talk back.
Taint rises. The Warden's patience does not.
Store ore near the refinery. Not in it.
A full belt is a happy belt.
Feed the inmates. They cannot eat the ore.
Waves come on schedule. Prepare for the schedule.
Nothing is as permanent as a temporary shed.
Research is optional. So is survival.

pod_lost: Your pod has been reclassified as debris.
The pod is gone. So is the point.
Pod lost. The Warden is disappointed in advance.
All that remains is the paperwork.
Colony closed due to extreme consequences.
all_dead: No staff remaining. The audit is over.
The colony has been fully discharged.
Roster empty. Lights stay on, sadly.

text: The gantry lights burn through the night.
You rise above the grey sky, debt unpaid but sentence ended.
Below, the planet keeps its poison and its teeth.
Somebody else will be sent to dig.

sentence._comment: Next Sentence letters. Keys '2','3' exact; '4+' for N >= 4. Placeholders: {n} sentence number, {vet} veteran name, {quota} quota percent. 'veteran' is added when a veteran carries over.

2.title: Release Processed
2.text: Your release has been processed. Your debt has been rolled over. Sentence {n} begins at once.

3.title: Welcome Back
3.text: Welcome back. You were never here. Sentence {n} has been issued, and the quota raised by {quota}%.

4+.title: Quota Notice
4+.text: Sentence {n}. The Warden has stopped counting your returns, but not your quota, which is up {quota}%.

veteran.title: Transfer Slip
veteran.text: Inmate {vet} is returned to the colony, experience on file. The Warden calls this efficiency.
